mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen in each of the four observed weeks (-24.7, -25.0, -25.3, -26.3); this monotone within-series momentum persists, so the next 28-day mean sits strictly below the trailing 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined in all four weekly means from -24.7 to -26.3
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days equals or exceeds the trailing 28-day mean, breaking the four-week monotone drift.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week WORKPLACES drop of 15 points or more marks an administrative closure shock; retail-and-recreation venues sit on the same closure schedule, so RETAIL_REC falls further over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week change <= -15 points (observed -19.4 from t-1w to t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved from -22.0 at t-1w to -41.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: Following a WORKPLACES week-on-week drop of 15 points or more, the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Joint collapse of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, each down more than 8 points week-on-week, removes the commuter corridor that supplies retail footfall; the co-movement itself, not either series alone, drives a further RETAIL_REC decline.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each fall >= 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell 8.8 points and WORKPLACES fell 19.4 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall together by >= 8 points each in a week, the following 14-day RETAIL_REC mean is flat or rising.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rising more than 3 points above its trailing four-week mean is a household confinement-compliance signal; with transit and parks already suppressed, discretionary retail visits fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds its trailing 4-week mean by >= 3 points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL jumped from 9.6 at t-1w to 13.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: After a RESIDENTIAL reading 3 or more points above its trailing 4-week mean, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is equal to or higher than the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The acute t-0w shock week drags down the trailing 28-day RETAIL_REC mean; if that shock week does not repeat, the next 28-day window contains only ordinary-restriction weeks and mechanically exceeds the trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week change <= -15 points in the most recent week
evidence_refs: fact:t-0w is the single worst week in all six series except GROCERY_PHARM relative to baseline
regime_hint: acute single-week shock inside a tightening regime
failure_condition: The next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is below the trailing 28-day mean, meaning the shock week recurs or severity deepens over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM recorded its largest four-week drop, -4.0 points to -16.3, showing households cutting even essential out-of-home errands; retail-and-recreation visits follow essentials downward within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from -12.3 at t-1w to -16.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the 7 days after a GROCERY_PHARM week-on-week drop of 3 points or more, RETAIL_REC is flat or higher than its t-0w level.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS printed a new four-week low of -40.1 together with falling transit and rising residential, a pattern consistent with cold-season outdoor avoidance layered on restrictions; the same avoidance suppresses RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -36.7 at t-1w to -40.1 at t-0w, a four-week low
failure_condition: After PARKS sets a new four-week low, the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RESIDENTIAL gains and TRANSIT losses mark substitution of out-of-home time for at-home time; the displacement of trips away from shared destinations transmits directly into a weaker RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL week-on-week change >= +2 points AND TRANSIT week-on-week change <= -8 points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose 3.7 points while TRANSIT fell 8.8 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: In 14-day windows where RESIDENTIAL rises >= 2 points and TRANSIT falls >= 8 points together, RETAIL_REC is flat or higher than the preceding 14 days.
